glossary.definition: A deepfake is synthetic media, usually video, images, or audio, generated by AI to convincingly show a real person saying or doing something they never actually did. It's a digital-age evolution of old-fashioned photo doctoring, except instead of touching up a still image with editing software, AI can now fabricate entire moving, talking footage that's difficult to distinguish from the real thing at a glance.

items.title: DeepSeek releases updated V4.1-Flash model it says completes tasks faster
items.summary: Chinese artificial intelligence startup Hangzhou DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence Basic Technology Research Co. Ltd. has released an updated version of its V4.1-Flash model that it says completes tasks faster. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 arrives a little over five weeks after the company launched the original V4.1-Flash as the smallest model in a new architecture family. ” DeepSeek did not say by how much.

items.title: Anthropic says it’s committing 5% of its shares to a ‘public benefit fund’
items.summary: Anthropic said that it will commit 5% of its shares to the fund. Anthropic announced today that it’s creating a “public benefit fund” that will give the company “increased flexibility and scale” to support projects for societal good. ” There’s also the impact that AI might have on the job market, which Anthropic has already committed $200 million to study . items.title: A woman was arrested in Philly for blocking a delivery robot
items.summary: Carolyn Marvin was arrested and charged with disorderly conduct after blocking the path of an Uber delivery robot and refusing to get out of the way. " Police responded to the scene and asked Marvin to move out of the robot's way. When she refused, they placed her in cuffs and arrested her. The incident was captured on video and has now garnered considerable media attention.

items.title: Disney agrees to hire the majority of Character.AI’s workforce
items.summary: AI employees who were offered jobs at Disney accepted them. However, this is a stalking horse bid, so another company could come forward with a higher offer. AI filed for bankruptcy earlier this week, many of its employees will have the opportunity to take jobs at Disney. AI’s former CEO Karandeep Anand recently became the entertainment giant’s first CTO , and the startup previously said that Disney had agreed to acquire some of its assets for $20 million.

items.title: Anthropic has nearly stopped hiring junior staff because AI agents now work six times as many hours
items.summary: Anthropic is hiring fewer and fewer junior staff in technical roles. The share of junior positions among new hires dropped from 27 to 9 percent since early 2025. By August 2026, AI agents across the company were already logging six times as many hours as humans. Researchers warn of a "tragedy of the cognitive commons": if junior positions disappear, experienced specialists will be in short supply down the road.

items.title: Four Gemini 4 Argon agents beat Minecraft without any human help
items.summary: Four AI agents running on Google's Gemini 4 Argon have beaten Minecraft for the first time without human help, slaying the Ender Dragon in a fully autonomous run. With no predefined roles or strategies, they coordinated on their own, wrote 2,783 programs, exchanged 229 chat messages, and died 605 times. The session cost $1,620. The Google Deepmind team dropped the agents into a randomly generated world without assigning roles, strategies, or game-specific tools.

items.title: OnlyFans Creators Are Pissed That Meta Lets Muse Talk Dirty
items.summary: Adult performers are questioning why Meta allows its AI agent to sext while restricting their social media accounts. The generative AI revolution hasn’t been kind to Vanniall, an OnlyFans creator who lives in New York City. She now constantly finds hyperrealistic deepfakes —AI-generated images and videos that copy everything about her— circulating online and often isn’t able to get them removed. On top of that, Vanniall struggles to build an audience on popular social media platforms, like Instagram , without getting in trouble.

items.title: Meta removes language that may have allowed it to scrape news sites
items.summary: After backlash, Meta is updating its terms again to remove language that suggested it could scrape content from sites, including news sites, to train its AI. Specifically, the following language no longer appears on the commercial terms page : … Meta may use any content from such domains, web pages, or URLs to provide, develop, improve, research, train, and maintain the integrity of, the Meta Company Products, services, and features provided under these Commercial Terms and any other applicable supplemental terms. Language that experts say allowed the scraping of news sites to train its AI has been removed from Meta’s terms. … Meta may use any content from such domains, web pages, or URLs to provide, develop, improve, research, train, and maintain the integrity of, the Meta Company Products, services, and features provided under these Commercial Terms and any other applicable supplemental terms.

items.title: ServiceNow AI Control Tower: Selling a penthouse while building the frame
items.summary: ServiceNow Inc. is making one of the more consequential and visible bets in enterprise artificial intelligence. The company says AI Control Tower can discover and govern any agent, work across models and clouds, track cost and value, and shut down behavior that violates policy. That sales pitch plays directly to ServiceNow’s greatest asset – its installed base.
